responsibility: Declares the public interface to GCC’s gimplification subsystem that lowers GENERIC trees to GIMPLE. It defines the fallback and gimplify_status enums, the gimple_predicate type, and the core entry points for managing gimplify contexts, lowering expressions, statements, arguments, sizes, bodies, and whole functions, as well as helpers for temporary variables, expression unsharing, OpenMP privatization support, boolification, operand predicates, va_arg lowering, and assignment construction.
same_name_distinction: Public header for the full gimplification subsystem, declaring context management, expression/body lowering, and helper APIs for converting GENERIC to GIMPLE; unlike gcc/gimplify.cc it contains declarations rather than lowering logic, and unlike gcc/gimplify-me.h it covers the main gimplifier rather than post-lowering regimplification helpers.
